name: Gladius / Neo (CUH-7xxx Pro)
notes: ps4_bridge.c: PCI_DEVICE_ID_CUH_7XXX; amdgpu_drv.c maps 0x9924 to CHIP_GLADIUS
The Pro's extra 1 GiB DDR3 belongs to OrbisOS background tasks and is not part of the Linux pool
